answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 19216 Country: Bangladesh Title: Difference between salat (namaz) of man and woman Question: I want to know the difference between salat(namaz) of man and woman with complete document from the Quran and Hadith, because some people declared that there is no difference between the same. Answer ID: 19216 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 135/135/M=1431) The answer to this question may be lengthy, therefore you are advised to get a copy of the following book: Namaz-e-Ahnaf (Urdu) by Mufti Habibur Rahman Qasmi Allahabadi. Study the book, it contains detailed information about the matter you asked. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
